# Assimp compatibility fixtures (T10)

Every file here is generated by `generate_fixtures.py` from repository-owned
primitives (a unit box, a small triangle grid and three hand-written triangle
faces). No third-party model, texture, exporter output or license is copied
into this directory. The generated bytes are committed because ADR-0029
requires byte-exact fixtures; rerunning the generator is deterministic.

| Fixture | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `box.dae` | Positive COLLADA box, one lambert material |
| `missing-texture.dae` | Positive geometry, authored `missing.png` (degraded) |
| `traversal-texture.dae` | Authored `../outside.png`; must fail typed |
| `box.3ds` | Positive binary 3DS box with a material group |
| `box.off` | Positive ASCII OFF box |
| `over-budget.off` | 300 triangles; fails only under the tiny-limit seam |
| `box.amf` | Positive AMF box with a material |
| `box.x3d` | Positive X3D IndexedFaceSet box |
| `box.x` | Positive DirectX text mesh |
| `triangle.dxf` | Positive DXF 3DFACE tetrahedron |
| `truncated.dae`, `truncated.3ds` | Truncated containers |
| `malformed.off`, `malformed.amf` | Structurally invalid syntax |
